normalizedDatabaseTables.purpose: Store every official or research source used by an imported tax model record.

columns.name: source_document_id
columns.notes: Stable content-addressed id, preferably sha256 of canonical URL plus retrieval timestamp plus source family.

columns.name: jurisdiction_code
columns.notes: Use state code, FIPS, municipal code, assessor code, tax area code, or official agency identifier as appropriate.

columns.name: evidence_text
columns.notes: Concise excerpt or paraphrased evidence sufficient for audit, not a long source copy.

normalizedDatabaseTables.purpose: Atomic source-backed facts extracted from documents before being attached to model records.
Canonical imported opportunity records from DSIRE, GPT Pro research, official files, or internal collection.
One opportunity can have multiple effects, each mapped to one safe model kind.
Route address, parcel, state, county, city, utility territory, or official boundary result to relevant tax opportunity effects.
Official GIS and boundary datasets used to determine tax jurisdiction, municipal assessor jurisdiction, approved zones, and special districts.
Source-backed rate rows, including sales/use tax rates, ordinary tax rates, preferential rates, local business taxes, per-unit charges, and statutory rates.
Safe, typed formulas that can be evaluated only with approved source-backed constants and taxpayer-specific runtime inputs.

columns.name: formula_dsl_json
columns.notes: Use a restricted expression tree, not arbitrary code.

normalizedDatabaseTables.purpose: Local business tax, local option, property adapter, assessor, treasurer, abatement, and PILOT workflows.
Canonical keys for taxpayer-specific inputs and whether an input can be inferred from geography.
Audit and rollback unit for imports from GPT Pro research or structured official files.
Record conflicts between imported facts, official sources, prior production records, and structured official files.

requiredIndexes.purpose: Support freshness checks by source family and authority.
Detect overlapping rates, formulas, exemptions, and local adoptions.
Detect duplicate opportunity imports across DSIRE, GPT Pro research, and official files.
Route one opportunity to one or more model-safe effects.
Fast runtime candidate lookup from normalized address geography.
Find all geography rules for an opportunity.
Detect geometry changes and support point-in-polygon lookups.
Runtime rate lookup and overlap validation.
Select eligible formula for a mapped effect.
Find local business tax and property adapter workflows.
Import audit and human review queue.

validationRules.rule: Every imported package must validate against the canonical schema for opportunities, effects, geography rules, local workflows, formulas, rates, sources, and runtime input definitions before semantic validation starts.
validationRules.codexAction: Reject the import batch when required top-level keys, primary keys, foreign keys, enum values, or required arrays are missing.

validationRules.rule: Every opportunity, effect, geography rule, formula, source document, source claim, rate, local workflow, and boundary dataset must have a deterministic id.
validationRules.codexAction: Generate ids only from stable natural keys such as source origin, jurisdiction, program id, model kind, effective date, and version; never use random ids for production records.

validationRules.rule: Rates, formulas, exemption treatment, credit amount, filing requirements, local adoption, boundaries, effective dates, and expiration dates require an official tax agency, statute, regulation, assessor, treasurer, municipal code, official form instruction, official program document, or official GIS/data source.
validationRules.codexAction: If only DSIRE, GPT Pro research, a vendor summary, or an unofficial article supports the material claim, import it as research context only and mark the calculable record source_unavailable or human_review_required.

validationRules.rule: GPT Pro research and DSIRE summaries may identify candidate programs but cannot override an official statute, official rate table, agency guidance, official form instruction, assessor source, treasurer source, municipal code, official GIS boundary, or executed program document.
validationRules.codexAction: Attach research summaries as source_authority_type research_summary and require at least one official source claim for each material executable fact.

validationRules.rule: Every source-backed material claim must include source_url, source_authority_type, evidence_text, retrieved_at, and content_hash.
validationRules.codexAction: Do not import claim_value_json into executable tables when evidence text is empty or source URL is missing.

validationRules.rule: Do not store taxpayer-specific facts as source-derived constants and do not store source-derived legal facts as user inputs.
validationRules.codexAction: Keys such as rates, statutory per-unit values, program phaseout schedules, eligible tax categories, and official boundaries are source-backed facts. Keys such as tax base, parcel id, tax bill lines, tax appetite, filing confirmation, local assessor confirmation, program approval, and taxpayer classification are runtime inputs.

validationRules.rule: Every effect must map to exactly one supported modelKind unless it is imported as unsupported_tax_model.
validationRules.codexAction: Use the framework mapping: sales/use rates to sales_use_tax_rate; sales/use exemptions to sales_use_tax_exemption; income/franchise/corporate credits to state_income_or_franchise_tax_credit; gross receipts and Washington B&O preferences to gross_receipts_or_bo_rate_preference; property exemptions to property_tax_exemption; property credits to property_tax_credit; special valuation formulas to property_tax_special_valuation; abatements and PILOTs to tax_abatement_or_pilot; local business taxes to local_business_license_or_receipts_tax; depreciation and deductions to depreciation_or_deduction.

validationRules.rule: Legacy valueModelKind values such as tax_exempt_liability, property_tax_valuation_formula, and tax_rate_difference are not runtime model kinds.
validationRules.codexAction: Translate each legacy value model to the canonical model_kind and preserve the legacy field only as source_import_metadata.

validationRules.rule: effect_type, tax_types, tax_type in geography rules, and model_kind must be internally consistent.
validationRules.codexAction: Reject combinations such as property_tax_valuation mapped to sales_use_tax_rate, local gross receipts mapped to property_tax_exemption, or B&O rate preference mapped to state_income_or_franchise_tax_credit.

validationRules.rule: Required inputs must include the common gates for the selected model kind unless the source supports not_applicable_zero_value.
validationRules.codexAction: For property tax models require tax_bill and assessor gates where savings are calculated. For credits require tax_return, filing_confirmation, and tax_appetite gates. For exemptions require tax_profile and filing_confirmation gates. For local business taxes require tax_return or tax_profile gates.

validationRules.rule: include_in_user_facing_total_default must be false unless formula, jurisdiction, source confidence, taxability, effective dates, required runtime inputs, and all filings or certifications support a calculated value.
validationRules.codexAction: Set include_in_user_facing_total_default to false for property tax workflows, abatements, B&O preferences, gross receipts preferences, deductions, depreciation, unsupported models, and any source_unavailable or human_review_required records.

validationRules.rule: Customer-facing savings must be $0 when a formula, jurisdiction, source confidence, required runtime inputs, effective dates, or filing status is missing.
validationRules.codexAction: Permit internal estimate fields only when clearly marked internal_only and blocked from user-facing totals.

validationRules.rule: Rate rows require effective_start_date. effective_end_date may be null only when the official source indicates current or open-ended treatment.
validationRules.codexAction: Do not infer rate start dates from retrieval date. Quarantine if the official source does not identify applicability period.

validationRules.rule: Statutory sunsets, phaseouts, program term limits, tax-year limits, and application deadlines must be stored as source-backed fields.
validationRules.codexAction: Do not collapse a phaseout or sunset into a generic current flag. Store phaseout multipliers or require runtime phaseout input when company/project-specific.

validationRules.rule: Local-option incentives require official local adoption, local ordinance, assessor confirmation, treasurer record, or official program agreement.
validationRules.codexAction: If state law allows local adoption but the municipality's adoption cannot be verified, route to needs_local_ordinance_confirmation and set customer-facing savings to zero.

validationRules.rule: Property tax savings require a source-backed or taxpayer-provided ordinary tax counterfactual, current tax bill, assessor value, levy lines, or official exemption certificate.
validationRules.codexAction: Compute statutory valuation internally only when the formula is source-backed; do not compute savings without counterfactual ordinary property tax and assessor or tax bill confirmation.

validationRules.rule: Boundary-derived eligibility requires an official GIS or official legal description source.
validationRules.codexAction: If only a narrative states a project is in a zone, require approved zone legal description and maps before runtime eligibility is calculated.

validationRules.rule: Geography can derive jurisdiction, tax area, official boundary intersection, and routing candidates only; it cannot prove taxpayer classification, qualified operations, filings, certifications, tax appetite, ordinary tax base, or compliance status.
validationRules.codexAction: Populate not_geography_derived_facts for all non-geographic eligibility criteria.

validationRules.rule: Sales/use tax savings require both a combined rate and source-backed taxability or exemption treatment for the matched equipment or service.
validationRules.codexAction: A rate alone is not an exemption and cannot produce savings without taxable basis and taxability treatment.

validationRules.rule: State income, franchise, and corporate tax credits may show gross statutory credit internally, but realized user-facing value requires refundability, transferability, direct pay, or taxpayer tax appetite and filing confirmation.
validationRules.codexAction: Separate gross_credit_cents from realized_credit_cents and default realized customer-facing value to zero when tax appetite is unknown.

validationRules.rule: Gross receipts and B&O rate preferences require tax-return or accountant inputs confirming classification, deductions, credits, and qualifying tax base.
validationRules.codexAction: Default to internal-only and human_review_required unless the taxpayer has supplied validated return inputs.

validationRules.rule: Local business license or receipts taxes require a confirmed local tax class and tax base, such as gross receipts, employee count, unit count, rental units, hotel receipts, or other source-backed base.
validationRules.codexAction: Do not calculate using inferred business category without user/accountant confirmation.

validationRules.rule: Structured official files must include provenance, official source URL or file origin, retrieval date, effective period, and field dictionary or schema.
validationRules.codexAction: Reject structured rows whose column meaning, units, jurisdiction, or applicability period cannot be traced to official metadata.

validationRules.rule: All monetary runtime outputs must be normalized to cents; percentage rates must be decimals; per-kW values must declare AC or DC; property rates must identify mills, dollars per thousand, or decimal rate.
validationRules.codexAction: Reject any formula where units cannot be reconciled without assumption.

validationRules.rule: Rates, caps, phaseout multipliers, and percentages must be within plausible legal bounds and cannot be negative unless the official source explicitly defines a refundable payment or rebate-like mechanism.
validationRules.codexAction: Flag negative, greater-than-one percentage credits, greater-than-one exemption multipliers, or rates above configured maximums for human review.

validationRules.rule: Formulas must use the approved restricted DSL only: constants, runtime inputs, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, min, max, clamp, round_cents, date_between, if_else, tier_lookup, and source_constant_lookup.
validationRules.codexAction: Reject arbitrary code, eval strings, external network calls, dynamic database writes, or untyped expressions.

validationRules.rule: Every formula variable must be declared as either a source-derived constant, derived geography fact, or required runtime input.
validationRules.codexAction: Reject formulas with undeclared variables or variables that mix source-backed and taxpayer-specific meanings.

validationRules.rule: Executable records require source_confidence high or medium. Low confidence may be stored for research but cannot be used for customer-facing savings.
validationRules.codexAction: Set can_produce_customer_facing_savings false when source_confidence is low, source_unavailable, stale_source, conflicting, or unverified.

validationRules.rule: Michigan Renewable Energy Renaissance Zones must map to tax_abatement_or_pilot or property_tax_exemption only when approved zone documents and eligible tax lines exist; otherwise route to approved-zone workflow with user-facing savings zero.
validationRules.codexAction: Do not treat Michigan state geography alone as proof of RERZ eligibility. Require approved_rerz_designation, zone maps, local unit approval, compliance status, phaseout year, and actual abated tax lines.

validationRules.rule: Rhode Island Renewable Energy Tax Valuation must map to property_tax_special_valuation and local_assessor_workflow; savings require municipal status, AC capacity, property classification, counterfactual ordinary annual property tax, and assessor confirmation.
validationRules.codexAction: Permit statutory per-kW calculation only as internal process value when source-backed; block customer-facing savings without counterfactual tax lines.

validationRules.rule: Washington solar manufacturing tax abatement must map to gross_receipts_or_bo_rate_preference for state B&O and must not include city B&O taxes unless a separate local city B&O workflow exists.
validationRules.codexAction: Require qualifying B&O classification, qualifying product/activity, tax period, qualifying tax base after deductions and Multiple Activities Tax Credit, ordinary rate, preferential rate, and annual tax performance report filing status.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: Resolve conflicts by authority hierarchy first: statute or enacted code, then regulation, then official tax agency guidance or official rate table, then official form instructions, then assessor or treasurer source for parcel-specific property taxes, then municipal code for local taxes, then official GIS or program agreement for boundaries and approved zones, then official annual reports, then research summaries or third-party indexes.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Higher authority wins only for the same jurisdiction, tax type, effective period, and claim type. If two authorities govern different dimensions, preserve both.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: More specific jurisdiction or taxpayer/activity treatment beats general treatment when both are official and effective for the same period.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: For example, a city business license tax formula can coexist with a state B&O rule, and a parcel-specific assessor record can coexist with a statewide valuation statute.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: When two official records conflict only because of different effective periods, split the record into non-overlapping effective intervals instead of overwriting.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Create separate rate, formula, or eligibility rows for each interval and close the prior row at the day before the new effective_start_date.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: A newer retrieval date does not supersede an older source if the official effective period does not supersede it.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Use retrieved_at for freshness and audit only; use effective dates and official applicability text for runtime.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: When a statute delegates rate publication to a tax agency and an official rate table provides current jurisdiction-specific rates, use the official rate table for rates and the statute for legal authority.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Attach both source claims. Do not duplicate the rate as two separate active rates.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: When agency guidance conflicts with statute or regulation, quarantine the executable claim unless the guidance is clearly applying a delegated calculation or administrative rule.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Set conflict_type source_authority_conflict and route to human_review_required.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: State enabling law proves that a local option may exist; local ordinance, local resolution, assessor record, treasurer record, or approved agreement proves adoption for a specific locality or project.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: If local adoption is absent, keep the state enabling law as a candidate workflow and mark the local effect needs_local_ordinance_confirmation.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: When official boundaries overlap unexpectedly, do not choose by area or name alone.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: For tax areas and special districts, require official tax area code, parcel record, or assessor/treasurer confirmation. Set runtime status needs_assessor_confirmation or human_review_required.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: Merge duplicate opportunities only when source origin, program name, jurisdiction, tax type, effective period, and official authority identify the same legal program.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Preserve alternate source IDs in aliases. Do not merge state and local implementations if the local adoption is a separate legal action.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: If two official formulas differ for the same tax type, jurisdiction, taxpayer class, and effective period, quarantine the formula unless one source is clearly superseded.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Set calculation formula to unsupported_tax_model for runtime until human review resolves the conflict.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: If two official rate values differ for the same jurisdiction, tax type, base, and effective date, prefer the source that is legally designated to publish rates; otherwise quarantine.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Do not average, interpolate, or infer rates.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: If an existing record's source is stale and a newer official source provides a different current value, close or supersede the existing record only when the new source has a clear effective date.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: If the new source lacks effective date, mark both stale_source or human_review_required rather than overwriting.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: If GPT Pro research, DSIRE, or third-party indexes disagree with official sources, official sources govern and the disagreement is logged as research_context_conflict.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Keep the official executable record and attach a warning to the import validation report.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: If source-backed legal rules are clear but taxpayer-specific documents conflict, do not modify source tables.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Return runtime status human_review_required and identify the conflicting taxpayer inputs.

conflictResolutionRules.rule: Incoming records cannot silently downgrade a production record from calculated to unsupported, or change include_in_user_facing_total_default from false to true.
conflictResolutionRules.codexAction: Require explicit migration flag and human review for changes that increase customer-facing savings exposure.

effectiveDateRules.rule: Executable rates, formulas, eligibility rules, and exemptions must have an effective_start_date from official source text, official metadata, statute effective date, tax year, or clearly identified agency rate table period.
effectiveDateRules.fallback: If no effective date is source-backed, import as source_unavailable or human_review_required.

effectiveDateRules.rule: retrieved_at may be used for freshness checks but must not be used as legal effective_start_date unless the source explicitly states the retrieved document applies as of retrieval.
effective_end_date may be null only when the source indicates no expiration, current ongoing treatment, or an open-ended statute or administrative rule.

When a statute, ordinance, program, or rate preference has a sunset or expiration date, store that date as effective_end_date or as a source-backed expiration field when the end applies to eligibility but not existing awards.

When a program phases out by year, term, or final-year multiplier, store each phaseout segment as a dated rule if dates are universal; otherwise require runtime inputs such as approved_zone_term_years, program_year, zone_final_year_and_phaseout_year, or phaseout_multiplier.
If a source applies by tax year rather than calendar date, store tax_year and derive calendar intervals only when the jurisdiction's tax year convention is source-backed.

Sales/use tax rates and exemptions are evaluated against transaction date, delivery date, or use date according to source-backed taxability rules. Do not use project completion date unless the source requires it.
Credits, deductions, exemptions, and depreciation rules that depend on placed-in-service or installation date must declare the required runtime date key.
Property tax rules must identify assessment date, lien date, tax year, roll year, or billing year when the official source makes the timing relevant.
Local-option incentives require local adoption effective date. State enabling law effective date alone is insufficient for local runtime calculation.
Boundary datasets must carry valid_from and valid_to when official metadata provides them. If absent, keep geometry current but flag boundary_dataset_validity_unknown in validation warnings.

For the same jurisdiction, tax type, taxpayer class, tax base, and claim type, overlapping effective date intervals with conflicting values are invalid unless the records represent separate stacked taxes or separate tax components.
When a filing or annual report requirement applies after the tax period, the formula may compute internal gross benefit but must block realized user-facing value until filing confirmation is present.
If a statutory amendment changes eligibility or benefit formula, preserve pre-amendment and post-amendment rows. Do not mutate historical rows.
Mark sources stale_source when they exceed their source family refresh cadence and no current official confirmation has been ingested.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: normalize_runtime_request
input: parcel id or APN when available
tax bill, tax return, filing, assessor, or program documents when available
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Normalize country, state, county FIPS, city, ZIP, parcel id, coordinates, tax year, transaction date, placed-in-service date, and project type. Do not infer legal eligibility from business name or description alone.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: derive_geography_from_official_sources
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Use official geocoding, official GIS, assessor parcel data, treasurer parcel data, and jurisdiction boundary datasets where available. If coordinates and parcel jurisdiction conflict, prefer official parcel/assessor data for property tax and flag human review.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: select_candidate_geography_rules
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Find tax_geography_rules matching country, state, county, city, official boundary, utility territory, parcel, or tax area code. Filter to rules effective during the relevant tax period. Preserve rules where locality_matters is true even if only partial geography is known, but mark missing geography inputs.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: expand_candidate_opportunities
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Join geography rules to opportunity_ids and then to tax_opportunity_effects. De-duplicate by opportunity_id, effect_id, model_kind, and effective period.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: classify_source_derived_and_taxpayer_inputs
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: For each effect, resolve derived_input_keys from source-backed claims and geography-derived facts. Resolve required_input_keys only from taxpayer documents, confirmed profile fields, official parcel/tax bill records, assessor confirmations, program documents, filing confirmations, or tax returns.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: check_source_freshness_and_confidence
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Block calculation when any material source claim is stale_source, source_unavailable, conflicting, or below the confidence threshold for executable records. Research summaries can keep a candidate visible but cannot make an effect calculated.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: resolve_effective_date_applicability
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Evaluate the correct date basis for each model kind: transaction or use date for sales/use tax, tax year for income/franchise/corporate and B&O/gross receipts, assessment/lien/billing year for property tax, and approved agreement period for abatements or PILOTs.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: map_model_kind_to_runtime_gate_status
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: If missing inputs remain, return the most specific status: needs_tax_bill for missing tax bill or levy lines; needs_tax_return for missing return or qualifying tax base; needs_assessor_confirmation for property value, classification, or parcel confirmation; needs_tax_profile for classification, use, taxability, or local business class; needs_program_documentation for approved zone/agreement/certification; needs_filing_confirmation for application or annual report; needs_tax_appetite for realized credit value; needs_local_ordinance_confirmation for unverified local adoption; human_review_required for conflicts; source_unavailable for missing official source; unsupported_tax_model for unmodeled formula.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_sales_use_tax_rate
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Calculate combined sales or use tax only when address or tax area, date, taxable basis, sourcing rule, and taxability treatment are source-backed or taxpayer-confirmed. If taxability treatment is unknown, return needs_tax_profile and customer_facing_savings_cents = 0.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_sales_use_tax_exemption
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Calculate exemption savings only when official source clearly exempts the matched equipment or service and certification, filing, purchaser, seller, and use requirements are satisfied. Otherwise return needs_filing_confirmation, needs_tax_profile, or human_review_required.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_income_or_franchise_tax_credit
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Compute gross statutory credit only from source-backed formula and taxpayer project basis. Compute realized user-facing value only when tax return, tax appetite, refundability, transferability, direct pay, carryforward, and filing confirmation are known. Otherwise set realized value to zero and status needs_tax_appetite or needs_tax_return.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_gross_receipts_or_bo_rate_preference
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Calculate internal-only tax difference as qualifying_tax_base_after_deductions_and_credits_cents multiplied by ordinary rate minus preferential rate, only when classification, qualifying activity, deductions, credits, and filing requirements are confirmed. Default customer-facing total to zero unless the validated package explicitly permits inclusion.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_property_tax_exemption_or_credit
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Require parcel id, current tax bill or assessor value, applicable levy lines, property classification, eligibility documentation, and filing or certificate confirmation. Never infer savings from project cost alone. If ordinary counterfactual is missing, return needs_tax_bill.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_property_tax_special_valuation
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Calculate statutory value internally only when source-backed constants and project inputs are present. Calculate savings only when ordinary ad valorem counterfactual and assessor confirmation are present. Otherwise return needs_assessor_confirmation or needs_tax_bill with customer_facing_savings_cents = 0.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_tax_abatement_or_pilot
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Require approved project/company/parcel agreement, legal boundary or parcel match, local approvals, compliance status, active term, phaseout status, eligible tax lines, and assessor or tax-return documentation. If any approval or eligible tax line is missing, return needs_program_documentation or needs_tax_bill and customer-facing savings zero.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_local_business_license_or_receipts_tax
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Calculate only from source-backed local formula and taxpayer-confirmed local tax class and base. Keep user-facing savings out of totals by default because ordinary local taxes are liabilities or internal cost estimates, not retrofit savings unless a supported incentive record exists.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: evaluate_depreciation_or_deduction
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Compute internal-only deduction or depreciation value when tax basis, placed-in-service date, eligible property class, taxpayer tax rate, and tax appetite are confirmed. Default to human_review_required and exclude from customer-facing totals.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: apply_current_package_specific_routes
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: For SOURCE_DSIRE:dsire_program_id:3216, route Michigan state matches to the RERZ approved-zone tax abatement workflow and require approved designation, maps, local unit approval, compliance, phaseout, and eligible tax lines. For SOURCE_DSIRE:dsire_program_id:22798, route Rhode Island matches to property_tax_special_valuation with municipal assessor workflow. For SOURCE_DSIRE:dsire_program_id:381, route Washington matches to state B&O rate preference only and exclude local city B&O unless a separate local workflow matches.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: calculate_or_block
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: If all source, effective-date, jurisdiction, formula, and runtime-input gates pass, evaluate the formula DSL and return calculated. If a source-backed rule says the tax does not apply or the taxpayer is outside scope, return not_applicable_zero_value. Otherwise return the most specific needs_* or unsupported status.

runtimeMappingAlgorithm.name: compose_runtime_response
runtimeMappingAlgorithm.logic: Set realized_customer_facing_savings_cents to zero unless the effect is calculated, source confidence is sufficient, no human review blockers remain, all filings/certifications are confirmed, and include_in_user_facing_total is allowed.

unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.name: detect_unsupported_conditions
unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.logic: Mark unsupported_tax_model when the opportunity uses a tax type, rate structure, valuation method, local adoption mechanism, boundary source, or taxpayer-specific workflow not represented by the supported modelKinds.

unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.name: detect_source_unavailable_conditions
unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.logic: Mark source_unavailable when a material rate, formula, eligibility rule, effective date, local ordinance, boundary, or filing requirement cannot be backed by official source evidence.

unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.name: preserve_research_context
unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.logic: Store the candidate opportunity, source summaries, unresolved claims, and requested model kind in non-executable research tables so the record can be repaired later without being used for calculations.

unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.name: return_safe_runtime_status
unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.logic: At runtime, unsupported and source-unavailable records return customer_facing_savings_cents = 0, include_in_user_facing_total = false, and runtime_status equal to unsupported_tax_model or source_unavailable.

unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.name: identify_repair_path
unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.logic: Attach repair_requirements such as official_rate_source_needed, official_formula_needed, local_ordinance_needed, boundary_dataset_needed, tax_bill_adapter_needed, filing_requirement_needed, taxpayer_profile_mapping_needed, or formula_dsl_extension_needed.

unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.name: avoid_partial_formula_execution
unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.logic: Do not execute a partially supported formula with default values. Missing rates, multipliers, caps, tax bases, or eligibility booleans must block calculation rather than being treated as zero unless the official source explicitly defines zero treatment.

unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.name: suppress_high_risk_records
unsupportedFallbackAlgorithm.logic: Set suppressed when an imported record would create misleading customer-facing savings, duplicates an unresolved conflicting production record, lacks official provenance, or cannot be mapped to a safe runtime status.

refreshCadenceBySourceFamily.stalenessRule: Mark possibly_stale after the state's published update cadence is missed; mark stale_source after one additional missed cycle or when the official rate table has a newer dated version.
Watch monthly for agency updates, legislative amendments, form instruction changes, and program sunset changes. Revalidate annually for the new tax year.
Revalidate against the annual assessment roll, tax bill cycle, or levy certification cycle. Check source availability monthly for portal, schema, and parcel adapter changes.
Revalidate by tax year and check quarterly for rate, classification, surcharge, deduction, credit, and filing changes.
Revalidate local code, assessor pages, treasurer pages, and official program agreements at least semiannually and whenever a new opportunity is collected.
No executable refresh required. Revisit only when a customer or research source produces a matching opportunity with official support.

codexImplementationNotes.note: Implement the importer as staged jobs: parse raw files, normalize sources, extract atomic claims, validate claims, create or update opportunities, map effects, create formulas and rates, create geography rules, create local workflows, run conflict detection, run test fixtures, then promote the batch.
Use import_batch_id for all created and updated records. Promotion to production should be atomic. If a reject_batch validation fires, no production records should change.
Quarantine invalid or conflicting incoming records with reasons rather than deleting them. This preserves research context and supports later model repair.
Runtime calculation should not fetch web sources. All source-backed constants, rates, formulas, boundaries, and evidence must already be imported and versioned.
Build a typed formula evaluator over a JSON expression tree. The evaluator must reject unknown operators, undeclared variables, mixed units, divide-by-zero, unbounded recursion, and arbitrary code.
Store money in integer cents and rates as fixed-precision decimals. Apply round_cents only at source-specified points or at final monetary output.
Create a unit normalization library for percentage decimals, mills, dollars per thousand, cents per unit, dollars per kW, AC kW, DC kW, square footage, employees, receipts, and tax years.
All required_input_keys and derived_input_keys must be registered in tax_runtime_input_definitions. The importer should fail unknown keys unless explicitly adding a new reviewed input definition.

When multiple blockers exist, return the highest priority runtime status in this order: suppressed, unsupported_tax_model, source_unavailable, stale_source, human_review_required, needs_program_documentation, needs_local_ordinance_confirmation, needs_assessor_confirmation, needs_tax_bill, needs_tax_return, needs_filing_confirmation, needs_tax_appetite, needs_tax_profile, not_applicable_zero_value, calculated.

Centralize the customer-facing savings guard in one function. It should require runtime_status calculated, include_in_user_facing_total_default true, human_review_required false, source_confidence high or approved medium, no missing inputs, no stale sources, and formula can_produce_customer_facing_savings true.
Every calculation response should separate internal_calculation_cents, gross_credit_or_exemption_cents, realized_customer_facing_savings_cents, and include_in_user_facing_total.

Run conflict checks for duplicate opportunities, overlapping effective dates, mismatched rates, mismatched formulas, ambiguous model kind, boundary overlap, local adoption unknown, source staleness, and unofficial-vs-official disagreement.

Map current package valueModelKind fields as import metadata only. Convert tax_exempt_liability to tax_abatement_or_pilot or property_tax_exemption depending on official sources; property_tax_valuation_formula to property_tax_special_valuation; tax_rate_difference to gross_receipts_or_bo_rate_preference for Washington state B&O.
Preserve the current WA, RI, and MI geography rules as seed rules but validate them through the same source-claim, evidence, effective-date, and user-facing-total gates as new imports.

Do not mix state incentive records with local business tax modules unless the source explicitly states a local incentive changes the local tax. A city B&O or business license workflow is a separate liability module unless tied to a source-backed incentive.

Property adapters should normalize parcel identifiers, tax bill terminology, levy lines, direct assessments, assessed values, taxable values, and exemption line items, but should not invent savings or ordinary counterfactual values.
Store boundary geometries or references in a spatial table with official source metadata and geometry hashes. Runtime should record which boundary version was used for an eligibility decision.
For every calculated output, log formula_id, formula version, source_claim_ids, source_document_ids, input values used, missing inputs, runtime status, and user-facing inclusion decision.
Implement scheduled freshness checks by source family. A freshness check should not change legal values unless a new official source is imported and validated.
Create queue views for human_review_required, source_unavailable, stale_source, needs_local_ordinance_confirmation, model_kind_ambiguous, formula_mismatch, and boundary_overlap conflicts.
Build fixture records for the 25 recommended test cases and require them in CI before promoting any importer or formula evaluator changes.

Runtime responses should explain missing requirements as structured blocker codes rather than free text only, so the product can request the correct tax bill, return, filing confirmation, assessor confirmation, program documentation, or tax profile input.

The importer and runtime must not default unknown booleans to false or unknown monetary values to zero except for final customer-facing savings suppression. Unknown eligibility inputs should block calculation.
Version formulas, rates, geography rules, boundary datasets, and local workflows. Historical calculations should be reproducible with the versions active at calculation time.
Expose source URLs and concise evidence summaries in internal APIs for every material calculated claim. External customer presentation can be filtered, but audit data must remain available.
